title: Kth Largest Element in a Stream
statement: The constructor takes k and a starting array. Each Add inserts a value and returns the kth largest element in the collection at that moment, counting duplicates.
constraints: the collection always has at least k elements when Add returns
hints: You never need the whole collection sorted, only the k largest of it.
Keep a min-heap holding exactly those k largest. Its root is the kth largest, which is the answer.
On each add, push and then drop the smallest while the heap exceeds size k. Run the constructor array through the same Add path rather than duplicating logic.
